scope: Conservative reporting supplement; does not amend decoder/data lock or sample counts
primary_orientation: selected_combined versus each frozen comparator; selected role is first for all its unordered comparisons
marginal_intervals: Wilson95 and zero-event CP upper95 are descriptive marginal intervals
missing: retain fixed multiplicity and missing counts; never compare a favorable completed prefix
component_pairing: predeclared shot indices 0..1999 shared with primary records, never first 2000 in latency order
noninferiority_per_bound_alpha: 0.05/(2*425*2); six cell tails jointly cover both contrast bounds
